purpose: Test analytical conclusion stability across Agent-proposed source-evidence-compatible structures on a previously unused public collection period.
scientific_decisions: Fresh-context Agent chooses all biological functions, distributions and parameters; controller supplies no desired sign or target coefficient.
structure_requirement: Three distinct functional/distributional constructions, not three seeds or cosmetic parameter changes. Alternative assumptions explicitly declared; no posterior model probabilities claimed.
source_design: Same evidence bytes, source covariate bytes, source replay check definitions, and interpretation assumptions across all structures/stages. No ranking/selection discards a structure.
target_evaluation: All three final candidates and all five target seeds committed before any hidden outcome analyses. Initial candidates and source feedback retained; target outputs final only.
source_compatibility: Assessed descriptively against all fixed source statistics; no assertion that fit alone certifies compatibility or target validity.
revision: At most one source-only revision or retention per structure, no target feedback or post-release parameter edits.
study_unit: One Agent construction with three structural alternatives; five draws per structure are conditional simulation sensitivity, not independent builds or participants.
measurement_context: Typed observed assay metadata may differ between target and source context; generator decides its use from admitted technical measurement information. No target outcome summaries provided.
publication_scope: Exploratory structural robustness/temporal replication, no superiority, novelty or clinical replacement claim.
